meta_title: Crypto payments & payouts for affiliate marketers · Dynopay
meta_description: Collect crypto payments and get paid globally as an affiliate marketer with Dynopay. 15+ cryptocurrencies, no chargebacks, fees from 1.5%. Start free today.
h1: Accept crypto payments as an affiliate marketer, anywhere in the world
subheading: Dynopay lets affiliate marketers and media buyers get paid in Bitcoin, stablecoins, and 15+ cryptocurrencies directly to a wallet they control — no borders, no chargebacks, no frozen balances.
intro_paragraph: Affiliate income crosses borders constantly, and traditional rails add currency conversion fees, slow bank transfers, and the risk of a frozen account when volume spikes. Dynopay is a non-custodial crypto payment gateway that settles straight to your wallet — collect payments for promotions, media, or your own offers with a payment link, hosted checkout, or the REST API across 15+ cryptocurrencies. Fees start at 1.5% and drop to 0.5% at scale, with no chargebacks, no monthly fees, and a fee-free first payment.

features.title: Get paid across borders, instantly
features.description: Crypto settles in minutes to a wallet you control, so you skip multi-day international bank transfers and the FX spread that eats into cross-border affiliate revenue.

features.title: No frozen accounts when volume spikes
features.description: A viral campaign won't trip a processor's fraud model and freeze your balance — non-custodial settlement means the funds are already yours.

features.title: Stablecoins to sidestep volatility
features.description: Take payment in USDT or USDC to hold a dollar-pegged balance, then convert to local currency whenever the rate suits you.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, create a company profile, and add one payout wallet address for settlement.
Share a payment link, embed checkout, or wire up the REST API to invoice partners and buyers.
They pay in their preferred cryptocurrency and funds arrive in your wallet within minutes.

faqs.question: How do affiliate marketers benefit from accepting crypto?
faqs.answer: Affiliate revenue is global and spiky. Crypto settles in minutes to a wallet you control, avoids international bank delays and FX spreads, and can't be frozen by a processor when a campaign suddenly scales.

faqs.question: Can I hold my earnings in a stable, dollar-pegged coin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Accept payment in stablecoins like USDT or USDC to keep a dollar-value balance and avoid crypto volatility, then convert to fiat on your own schedule.

faqs.question: Which cryptocurrencies are supported?
faqs.answer: Dynopay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Solana, XRP, TRX, MATIC, and stablecoins such as USDT (ERC20, TRC20, Polygon), USDC (ERC20), and RLUSD.

faqs.question: What does Dynopay charge?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per successful payment and drop to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. No setup fees, no monthly fees, and your first payment is free.

faqs.question: Is Dynopay custodial? Where do my funds go?
faqs.answer: Dynopay is non-custodial. Payments settle directly to your own wallet — MetaMask, Coinbase, Ledger, or any address you control — so Dynopay never holds your money.

cta_body: Sign up now and your first transaction is fee-free. No monthly costs and funds settle straight to a wallet you control.
